patch_description: The current program is a single function that generates a contact plan. By refactoring it, we can break down the logic into smaller, more manageable functions. This will improve the code's readability and maintainability. Each function will handle a specific part of the plan generation process, such as initializing the plan, appending modes, and walking. This modular approach will also make it easier to test and modify individual parts of the plan generation process.
